title: Add semantic labels to icon-only pace/chazara stepper buttons
why: _StepperButton (the pace +/- control in Edit Track's goal editor, wired to onPaceDecrease/onPaceIncrease) and TinyCircleButton (the chazara review-round +/- control used from chazara_widgets.dart's CustomDayEditorChip in both Add Track and Edit Track) are bare Material+InkWell+Icon with no Semantics/tooltip/label. A screen-reader user gets no spoken description — not even 'button' — for either control, so they cannot set a pace goal's numeric target or adjust a chazara delay day count with TalkBack/VoiceOver. The correct pattern already exists in the same batch: goal_cards.dart's BlurInactiveGoalOption wraps its tap target in `Semantics(button: true, label: hint, ...)`.
recommendation: Wrap both widgets' InkWell in Semantics(button: true, label: <localized increase/decrease description>) or add a tooltip, matching goal_cards.dart's existing pattern.
acceptance_criteria: _StepperButton and TinyCircleButton each expose a non-empty Semantics label for their increase/decrease actions
A widget test finds a Semantics node with a button role and non-empty label at each control's location

corrections: 'wired to onPaceDecrease/onPaceIncrease' overstates precision — actual code uses anonymous closures `() => setState(() => _paceValue--)` / `++`, no such named callbacks exist. Cosmetic only.
